name: bld_sum_inv_sqrt_div_sqrt_tendsto
statement: : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, 1 / Real.sqrt ((i : ℝ) + 1)) / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 2)
closed: Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, 1 / Real.sqrt ((i : ℝ) + 1)) / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 2)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.an2_sum_inv_sqrt_bounds: squeeze between 2(sqrt(n+1) - 1)/sqrt n and 2, both tending to 2.
type: Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, 1 / √(↑i + 1)) / √↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 2)
